steps.content: The black swamp around recedes, and the girl you "woke up" stands before you, not daring to resist, muttering the information she knows.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: According to L.L., her power seems to come from the bottom of the sea or some place like that. She's like a fish and needs to live in water. That's why she keeps taking us to the seabed.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Those people from under the sea... Or is it under... ground? They said that as long as Elysiland created by L.L. can gather enough emotional energy, then L.L. herself can enjoy many experiences she has never had before.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: She likes to see everyone has their desires fulfilled, to see everyone indulge in pleasure, as if that would also bring her joy...

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: She also said... everyone would always stay with her, because... once people find out how easy it is to satisfy a desire on Elysiland, no one can resist the temptation to stay.
Shrooma curls up, poking the soft sand with her fingers, creating pits and holes in the white beach.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: That's why I don't want to leave! A poisonous mushroom is only safe when buried in the mud... But there's no place for filthy mud or poisonous mushrooms in this world.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: I just hope to live happily in this world.
Shrooma wipes her eyes, a bit sulky, and turns her head away.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Now you've woken people like us up, cutting off the joy and the energy. That's why my swamp is gone.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: ...Was that useful? Can I leave now?
Before looking for L.L., you encountered a little girl who was trying her best to protect L.L. And that child was right, Elysiland seems to be fulfilling everyone's desires, making everyone indulge.

But what you finally arrive at is this chaotic scene. Monsters howl and rise, and the island and ocean tremble continuously under L.L.'s agitation. Every piece of land underfoot becomes sticky and soft, like an inescapable spider web, soon to be swallowed by Mania.
And the culprit, the owner of Elysiland, this beautiful girl in front of you, stands alone in the open square, smiling at you.
In the end, the so-called Elysium has left her alone in it.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You're my last guest. You stay on this island for so long, knowing full well of its illusory and dangerous nature, without giving in to its influence... You're the most clearheaded person I've ever seen.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I really want to know, have you ever succumbed to anything?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Is there anything you want, something you long for, something that spurs you to keep going? Is there a desire you just can't resist?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Tell me, I'll make it happen for you, Elysiland will fulfill all your desires! It must take an unparalleled thrill to make someone as sensible as you lose your mind. Whatever it is, I want to try it!

Her expression and words are full of joy. Her frenzied words melt into the water like seaweed entangling a diver's body, wrapping around your limbs and torso, flooding your mouth and nose, muddying your consciousness, trying to make you sink with her.
But you refuse. The shackles disperse the power entangling you, and fly straight towards L.L.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't need the happiness you create.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shut down Elysiland, leave the dark web and come back with me. I can't let you and those behind you run loose anymore!
L.L. dodges your shackles, swims up in the water, and laughs even more cheerfully.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hahaha! You don't want to tell me? That's okay, I'll get to know you, and so will this island. Let's take it slow!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: It's just you and me now. The next part is custom-made for you! I will satisfy you in the most perfect way!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Please enjoy yourself to the fullest, and satisfy me with your joy!
The underwater scene rapidly changes, everything starts to twist and dissolve, even you feel yourself being deconstructed, rearranged, and reassembled.
Countless pieces of information surge up. Every guest's past flashes before your eyes. Your brain receives too much information, making you feel sick, but you can't back down.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There are indeed times when I have desires, but that will not be happening here.
You take a step closer to her, determined.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you won't stop here, even if this island is destroyed, you will find a way to gain the Mania you need to create another one.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I won't let this happen again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I will stop you from creating Elysiland once and for all.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But, if this really happens again, you can come to my Elysiland once more like a piece of cake, can't you?
L.L. also takes a step closer to you, with one hand behind her back, looking at you obediently, with an "I knew it all along" expression.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You must have someone very proficient in computers or networks on your side, who can get you to Elysiland even without my invitation, right? And they hide your traces very well too.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I tacitly allowed your entry and permitted you to do anything you wanted on the island.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: So why are you stopping me now?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Or... do you just like being a hero?
L.L. taps her chin with her finger, frowning with her eyes closed, thinking for a while, then suddenly seems to think of something and smiles at you again.
You have seen her with this expression before...
...when she dragged everyone to the bottom of the sea.
